enabled.name: Enable context compression
enabled.hint: Enable or disable the entire compression pipeline.

zh.name: 启用上下文压缩
zh.hint: 启用或禁用整个压缩管道

anchor_size.name: Anchor rounds
anchor_size.hint: Number of most recent conversation rounds kept as original text. Messages beyond this are candidates for compression.

zh.name: 锚定轮数
zh.hint: 保留为原文的最近对话轮数，超出部分进入压缩候选

max_context_rounds.name: Max context rounds
max_context_rounds.default: 读取自框架 bot.max_memory_length，无需手动设置
max_context_rounds.hint: Trigger threshold is auto-read from the framework's bot.max_memory_length config.

zh.name: 最大上下文轮数（自动）
zh.hint: 触发阈值自动读取框架 bot.max_memory_length 配置，无需手动设置

max_chars_per_group.name: Max chars per compression group
max_chars_per_group.hint: Maximum characters per group when compressing. Shorter rounds are batched together; long rounds (e.g. with large tool results) are compressed individually.

zh.name: 每组压缩最大字符数
zh.hint: 压缩分组时每组最大字符数。短轮次合并压缩，长轮次（如大工具结果）单独压缩

use_persona_in_compression.name: Use persona for compression
use_persona_in_compression.hint: When enabled, the active persona text is injected into the compression prompt so summaries reflect the character's tone and vocabulary.

zh.name: 使用人设进行压缩总结
zh.hint: 开启后，会将当前激活的人设注入压缩提示词，让摘要更贴合角色语气与风格

compression_model.name: Compression model
compression_model.hint: LLM used for compression summaries. Leave empty to use the default fast LLM.

zh.name: 压缩模型
zh.hint: 用于生成压缩摘要的 LLM，留空则使用默认 fast LLM

preprocess_tool_results.name: Preprocess tool results
preprocess_tool_results.hint: Summarize long tool results (search, image descriptions, etc.) in the cache before they enter the compression pipeline. Keeps the original context unchanged.

zh.name: 预处理工具结果
zh.hint: 在缓存中总结过长的工具结果（搜索、图片描述等）后再进入压缩管道。原上下文不动

tool_result_max_chars.name: Tool result max chars
tool_result_max_chars.hint: Tool results longer than this will be summarized during preprocessing.

zh.name: 工具结果最大字符数
zh.hint: 超过此长度的工具结果将在预处理时被总结

summary_max_chars.name: Summary max chars
summary_max_chars.hint: Maximum characters for the final injected summary block.

zh.name: 摘要最大字符数
zh.hint: 最终注入的摘要块最大字符数

summary_prefix.name: Summary prefix marker
summary_prefix.default: [对话历史摘要 - 以下是你与用户之前对话的关键信息，不是用户当前说的话]
summary_prefix.hint: Text prepended to the summary block so the LLM knows it's context history, not the user's current message.

zh.name: 摘要前缀标记
zh.hint: 加在摘要块前面的文本，让 LLM 知道这是对话历史摘要而非用户当前发言

async_compression.name: Async compression
async_compression.hint: Run compression in the background so it doesn't block message responses. The summary may lag by 1 round.

zh.name: 异步压缩
zh.hint: 后台运行压缩，不阻塞消息回复。摘要可能落后 1 轮

inject_on_mismatch.name: Inject summary on context mismatch
inject_on_mismatch.hint: When the real context no longer matches the cache (e.g. history was cleared in WebUI): OFF clears the cache and starts fresh (safest); ON compresses all cached rounds into a summary and injects it, preserving memory at the risk of stale information.

zh.name: 上下文不匹配时注入摘要
zh.hint: 当真实上下文与缓存严重不匹配时（如在 WebUI 清空了历史）：关闭=清空缓存重新开始（最安全）；开启=将缓存中的历史压缩为摘要注入，保留记忆但可能包含过时信息

debug_log.name: Debug logging
debug_log.hint: Log detailed compression pipeline info for debugging.

zh.name: 调试日志
zh.hint: 输出详细的压缩管道调试信息
